summary.content:
Today's selection covers 71 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Like Anthropic, OpenAI Will Share Latest Technology Only With Trusted Companies
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: McGraw-Hill confirms data breach following extortion threat
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 39 articles published in the last 24 hours

all.title: Adobe Patches Actively Exploited Zero-Day That Lingered for Months

all.title: Critical flaw in wolfSSL library enables forged certificate use

all.title: Quantum computing: A tech race Europe could win?

all.title: Why Orgs Need to Test Networks to Withstand DDoS Attacks During Peak Loads

all.title: Empty Attestations: OT Lacks the Tools for Cryptographic Readiness
